_comment: Copy to config/publish-scrub.json (private, never published) and list YOUR identifiers. scripts/publish-engine.ps1 refuses to run without it. Replacements are applied to engine-bound files; deny patterns (case-insensitive regex) block a publish; a line matching an allow regex is never flagged. Built-in checks also catch emails, home-folder paths, Tailscale IPs/*.ts.net names and private LAN IPs.
